target.title: fix: redact diagnostic config fields with schema hints [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users exporting Gateway diagnostics could receive a support bundle whose sanitized config missed schema-marked sensitive provider request fields when those fields had generic names.

## Why This Change Was Made

The diagnostics export now runs config sanitization through the same schema hint redaction path used by config-facing surfaces before applying support-bundle redaction. Support output also converts the internal redaction sentinel to the public `<redacted>` marker so exported JSON remains readable and contains no internal marker values.

## User Impact

Users can share diagnostics bundles with fewer manual checks around provider request auth and TLS transport settings. Existing shape summaries, log redaction, status snapshots, and health snapshots are unchanged.

## Evidence

- AI-assisted.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --write --threads=1 src/logging/diagnostic-support-export.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-redaction.ts src/logging/diagnostic-support-export.test.ts`
- AWS Crabbox focused test passed: `corepack pnpm test src/logging/diagnostic-support-export.test.ts` on `run_cecb06fbaf6c`, lease `cbx_96242da8d98d`, 10 tests passed.
